target_questions.question: Does coordinated injector geometry and pressure provide independent application-scale evidence for mixing-performance tradeoffs?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A030 identifies jet geometry as a preignition-interaction control; this commercial-engine experiment extends the scale and hardware.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: Commercial-engine tests show that larger injector flow area can strengthen turbulence and mixture formation, but excessive dispersion increases wall impingement and unburned hydrocarbons.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Five injector designs and a 200-300 bar pressure sweep resolve a beneficial-to-adverse dispersion transition.

limitations: One medium-to-high-load engine condition; design variables are coupled.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
